company.shortDescription: OpenFoundry is a software development firm that provide platform to developer community for open source AI.
company.description: OpenFoundry provides a platform for developers to build and deploy AI-powered products. The platform allows users to find open source AI models for specific use cases. The software supports deploying AI products to cloud environments quickly. It offers tools to manage the AI development workflow from testing to production.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,011,803 to $9,796,131, a 1.4x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 92 (+29 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
